title: W11169652 — Quick Service Cycle
description: Run Quick Service Cycle after Service Diagnostic mode is active.

steps.title: Console control panel?
steps.body: Console models use membrane buttons and a seven-segment display. LCD-in-door models use the TOOLS menu and touchscreen — answer No for those.

steps.title: Console — run Quick Service Cycle
steps.body: Press the 2nd button used to enter Service Diagnostic mode (momentary). Display should show 001. Use Soil to increment or Temp to decrement until function 012 (Quick Service Cycle) is selected. Press START — display flashes 012 while the cycle runs (drum must be empty). Exit with POWER or hold the 1st diagnostic button for 5 seconds.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use Soil and Temp buttons to select function 012 Quick Service Cycle... Press START... display will flash 012 while the cycle runs.

steps.title: LCD — run Quick Service Cycle
steps.body: From DIAGNOSTICS HOME, scroll to Component Activation. Select Quick Service Cycle 1 and toggle ON (door will lock). Drum must be empty. Toggle OFF when finished. Exit diagnostic mode: scroll to top, press < twice, then HOME.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Scroll down and select Component Activation... Turn Quick Service Cycle 1 On.
